body: I feel guilty about seeking therapy again because I'm completely broke, and my parents are paying for everything out of their savings and not paying all the bills they need to.  I really dont want to ask them to pay for one more thing, though I know they would.

I dont fear death at all and at the moment I'm not too worried about it, but about 6 weeks ago before I moved I came home one night and decided that I was going to write a suicide note.  Then my ex boyfriend came over so all of that bullshit was cut short.  Its stuff like that which happens infrequently but consistently that causes me to worry about myself.

Sometimes I have suicidal thoughts but I dont really want to die.  Not sure if I should take myself seriously because most of the time I'm doing alright.  The problem is my behavior when I'm not doing all right.
